compounddef.initializer: template<typename H> concept scl::hash::concepts::byte_hasher = ::std::default_initializable<H> && requires { typename H::result_type; } && ::std::integral<typename H::result_type>

briefdescription.para: Concept satisfied by any default-constructible callable that maps a byte range to an integral digest and exposes a result_type typedef.

detaileddescription.para: Used to constrain the Hasher parameter of scl::hash::key.
